sentences: A min-plus weighted automaton assigns a word the minimum total weight among its accepting runs.
The task is to decide whether a given machine has any equivalent deterministic weighted automaton.
It asks about existence of a deterministic representation, rather than simply applying a particular conversion construction.
The source identifies polynomial ambiguity as a decidable restriction and places the difficulty in unrestricted competing runs.
A general criterion would characterize when optimal costs from many possible computations can instead be maintained by one finite-state computation.
